signal: Workrise raised a $300M Series E led by Baillie Gifford and is expanding beyond energy into solar, wind, construction, and defense markets

email.body1:
Rhett, saw Workrise raised its $300M Series E and is expanding into solar, wind, construction, and defense.

Entering new markets that fast usually means more accounts in play than the team can cover before reps ramp on each vertical, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Workrise off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Rhett, quick follow-up for Workrise.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can, and four new verticals multiply the addressable list. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the new number across markets.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Workrise needs to cover the expansion this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Rhett, last bit of proof for Workrise.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Workrise reply rate likely compares to other late-stage platforms. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Rhett, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority right now, no problem. Standing up four new verticals is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a multi-vertical motion? I will tailor it to Workrise either way.
